faq.title: Have Questions?
faq.description: Everything you need to know about our admissions, routines, and policies.

items.question: What age groups do you accept for enrollment?
items.answer: We warmly welcome children between the ages of 3 months and 5 years old. Our engaging rooms are thoughtfully tailored to support infant care, toddler exploration, and preschool school-readiness.

items.question: What are your regular operating hours and drop-off times?
items.answer: We operate Monday through Friday from 7:30 AM to 6:30 PM year-round, with flexible full-day and morning/afternoon session options available to suit busy working families.

items.question: What are your staff-to-child ratios and safety standards?
items.answer: We strictly adhere to and exceed UK EYFS ratios (1:3 for babies under 2, 1:4 for toddlers aged 2-3, and 1:8 for preschool). All staff are Enhanced DBS checked and Paediatric First Aid certified.

items.question: What meals and dietary requirements do you cater for?
items.answer: Our on-site chef prepares balanced, fresh two-course hot meals and nutritious snacks daily. We gladly cater for all allergies, intolerances, halal, vegetarian, and vegan requirements.

items.question: Do you accept government childcare funding and tax-free vouchers?
items.answer: Yes! We accept the 15 and 30-hour government funded childcare schemes for eligible 9-month to 4-year-olds, Tax-Free Childcare, and employer childcare vouchers.
